decision.reason: The only evidence for this change is a file listing: ciliumnodeconfigs.yaml appears under crds/v2 at v1.17.0 [ev-2be643334952] but not in the v1.15.6 crds/v2 listing [ev-c4d8808f9d36, ev-27da5c1705fe]. Every excerpt is just "---", so the CRD content is not shown. The title says the CRD serves both v2 and v2alpha1. The v1.15.6 crds/v2alpha1 directory is not in the evidence, so we can't tell whether this CRD is really new or already shipped there and only moved. The evidence also can't confirm the from-version boundary "<1.17.0", and none of it says that a missing CRD makes anything fail. Exposure also seems to depend on whether CRDs are managed separately from the release, which this condition doesn't capture. To decide, we need the CRD manifest content and the v2alpha1 CRD listing for the from-release.
